description: Code-first screen after Mark Minervini, Trade Like a Stock Market Wizard (2013), ch. 5 and 10: on ~150 US large caps plus the 11 sector SPDRs with median 50-day dollar volume >= $50M, the 8-point Trend Template (price above rising SMA150/200, SMA50 above both, >= 30% above the 52-week low, within 25% of the high, RS rank >= 70) and a volatility contraction pattern (2-6 successively smaller pullbacks, drying volume) breaking its pivot on >= 1.4x the 50-day volume. Long, 30-bar hold, stop at the last contraction low capped at 8%, at most 3 calls a day. One optional Flash call writes a catalyst note from headlines; no call depends on it.
output_character: 0-3 long calls a day on US large caps / sector ETFs breaking out of a VCP; 30-bar hold; code stop under the last contraction (max 8%)
public_data_sources: public daily price bars via gateway.price_history (complete bars only)
NASDAQ Trader symbol directory (universe.equities) to drop delisted seed symbols
public news titles from the Playground context (untrusted, defanged; catalyst note only)
